newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle buys Michigan insurance agency.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle buys Michigan insurance agency.

text.p: Pinnacle Financial Services Inc said Tuesday it purchased Starke's Inc, an independent insurance agency headquartered in St. Joseph, Mich.
Pinnacle Financial is the parent company of Pinnacle Bank - Michigan and Pinnacle Bank - Indiana and had total assets of about $1 billion at September 30, 1996.
The Michigan bank and Starke's have had a long association as mutual customers since 1933. There are no present plans for the insurance agency to change its name.
Pinnacle Financial said this acquisition gives it a more comprehensive array of product offerings for customers.
Shares of Pinnacle Financial were up 1/2 to 24-3/4.
